description: This file defines the class ListViewSubPanel, which manages rendering of subpanel list views within the SuiteCRM system. It handles template initialization, dynamic list view processing, pagination controls, and security considerations for subpanel displays.

classes.name: ListViewSubPanel
classes.description: Handles the display and processing of list views within subpanels, including template setup, list processing, pagination, security checks, and interactions with the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewSubPanel object, setting up the Smarty template instance.

methods.name: initNewSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new Smarty template with a given path and optional module strings and image paths, validating that the template file has a .tpl extension.

methods.name: getSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Returns the current Smarty template instance.

methods.name: setSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Sets the Smarty template instance to the provided template object.

methods.name: smartyTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the Smarty template, creating the template if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: createSmartyTemplate
methods.description: Creates a Smarty template object based on the stored template path and assigns standard variables.

methods.name: setCurrentModule
methods.description: Sets the current module context and updates the Smarty template accordingly.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview
methods.description: Processes and renders a dynamic list view for a given module and bean, handling headers, rows, and display logic.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview_header
methods.description: Prepares and assigns the header row for a dynamic list view, including sorting links and column definitions.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview_rows
methods.description: Prepares and assigns the data rows for a dynamic list view, including security checks, custom fields, and widget rendering.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Handles the pagination controls for list views, including navigation buttons, URL management, and associated JavaScript.

methods.name: processOrderBy
methods.description: Constructs and manages the URL for ordering the list view by specific columns, updating the Smarty template.
